text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There is no more doubt in Symboli Rudolf's eyes. She sees her path clearly, and it leads her to a storied race of great prestige.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The newly reborn Emperor is ready to compete in the spring Tenno Sho, where she will surely set a tempest whirling.
